title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Release and Expiry of Free Night Awards
content:
**R1. When an applied award is released.** An applied Free Night Award is released back to the member's account when its reservation is cancelled with a cancellation timing of before the deadline and the award type's terms return the award on a timely cancellation, or when the hotel relocates the reservation. On a late cancellation or a no-show, awards on nights after the first night are released too.

**R2. Reservation state.** An award is released only from a reservation whose status is cancelled, no-show or relocated, as the reservation record in the system shows it.

**R3. Top-off points.** Top-off points come back with the award when the award type's terms return top-off points on release.

**R4. Expiry date kept.** A released award keeps its original expiry date.

**R5. When an award expires.** An award expires only after its expiry date has passed. The award expires at the end of its expiry date: it is still usable for a night on the expiry date, and it becomes expired on the following calendar day, that is, 1 calendar day after the expiry date shown on the award record. On any day up to and including the expiry date the award has not expired; from the following calendar day onward it has.

**R6. Expired award on release (no longer in force).** The former clause under which a released award whose expiry date had already passed therefore expired on the day it was released, where the award type's terms so provided, and was never reinstated for a new stay, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis.

**R7. Replacement.** Only when the release was caused by a relocation and the award type's terms reissue an award released after its expiry date because of a relocation is a replacement of the same type issued, under the reissue rules of the Free Night Awards.

## Expiry boundary (hypothetical award with an expiry date of 30 June)

| Day | Award state under R5 | Night on that day |
|---|---|---|
| 29 June | Not expired | May be covered |
| 30 June, the expiry date | Not expired | May be covered |
| 1 July, the following calendar day | Expired | Cannot be covered |

## Release outcomes (hypothetical reservations)

| What happened to the reservation | Awards released under R1 |
|---|---|
| Cancelled with timing before the deadline, under terms that return the award on a timely cancellation | Every award on it |
| Relocated by the hotel | Every award on it |
| Cancelled with timing after the deadline | Awards on nights after the first night |
| Became a no-show | Awards on nights after the first night |

superseded_clauses: A released award whose expiry date has already passed therefore expires on the day it is released when reinstate_requires_unexpired is true; it is never reinstated for a new stay.
